selection: Ascending SHA256 of seed|stratum|catalog_id within geometry-only strata; no image, width or outcome selection
visibility: Candidate's own highest point; closed cuboid tangency at positive ray distance blocks; all query heights in all camera fields of view
oracle: Exactly three visibility bits for current query only; no cross-query conditioning, pixel correspondence, stratum or depth input
aggregation: Equal queries within scene, equal scenes; S=1-mean(W_oracle)/mean(W_base); zero denominator means no room
scope: Finite noiseless sampled orthographic silhouette experiment; same-azimuth oblique views, known uniform radiometry and restricted cuboid geometry. Not photorealistic RGB, RPC, physical footprint, learned-method evidence or cross-city confirmation.
